WHERE
  { { SELECT DISTINCT  ?var1 (GROUP_CONCAT(concat(?var4Label, " <sup>(", ?var5, ")</sup>") ; separator=', ') AS ?var2)
      WHERE
        {   { ?var1  wdt:P16  wde:Q106123 }
          UNION
            { ?var1  wdt:P31  wde:Q106123 }
          OPTIONAL
            { ?var1  rdfs:label  ?var4Label
              FILTER langMatches(lang(?var4Label), "*")
            }
          BIND(lang(?var4Label) AS ?var5)
        }
      GROUP BY ?var1
    }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  wdt:P1824  ?var3 }
    BIND(strlen(str(?var3)) AS ?var6)
    BIND(substr(str(?var3), 1, 1) AS ?var7)
    BIND(substr(str(?var3), 2, ( ?var6 - 1 )) AS ?var8)
    BIND(replace(substr(str(?var8), 1, 4), "[A-Za-z]", "") AS ?var9)
    BIND(strlen(str(?var9)) AS ?var10)
    BIND(concat(if(( ?var10 = 1 ), "000", if(( ?var10 = 2 ), "00", if(( ?var10 = 3 ), "0", ""))), str(?var9)) AS ?var11)
    BIND(concat(str(?var7), str(?var9)) AS ?var12)
    BIND(strlen(str(?var12)) AS ?var13)
    BIND(( ?var6 - ?var13 ) AS ?var14)
    BIND(substr(str(?var3), ( ?var13 + 1 ), ?var14) AS ?var15)
    BIND(concat(str(?var7), str(?var11), str(?var15)) AS ?var16)
    OPTIONAL
      { SELECT  ?var1 (COUNT(?var17) AS ?var18)
        WHERE
          {   { ?var1  wdt:P16  wde:Q106123 }
            UNION
              { ?var1  wdt:P31  wde:Q106123 }
            ?var1  wdt:P17  ?var17
